params.name: id

params.name: transaction_code

items.docs:
Retrieves the full details of an identified transaction. The transaction resource is identified by a query parameter and *one* of following parameters is required:
- `id`
- `transaction_code`
- `foreign_transaction_id`
- `client_transaction_id`

params.name: merchant_code
params.description: Merchant code of the account whose transaction history should be listed.

params.name: transaction_code
params.description: Retrieves the transaction resource with the specified transaction code.

params.name: order
params.description: Specifies the order in which the returned results are displayed.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of results per page. Value must be a positive integer and if not specified, will return 10 results.

params.name: users
params.description: Filters the returned results by user email.

params.name: statuses[]
params.description: Filters the returned results by the specified list of final statuses of the transactions.

params.name: payment_types
params.description: Filters the returned results by the specified list of payment types used for the transactions.

params.name: entry_modes[]
params.description: Filters the returned results by the specified list of entry modes.

params.name: types
params.description: Filters the returned results by the specified list of transaction types.

params.name: changes_since
params.description: Filters the results by the latest modification time of resources and returns only transactions that are modified *at or after* the specified timestamp (in [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format).

params.name: newest_time
params.description: Filters the results by the creation time of resources and returns only transactions that are created *before* the specified timestamp (in [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format).

params.name: newest_ref
params.description: Filters the results by the reference ID of transaction events and returns only transactions with events whose IDs are *smaller* than the specified value. This parameters supersedes the `newest_time` parameter (if both are provided in the request).

params.name: oldest_time
params.description: Filters the results by the creation time of resources and returns only transactions that are created *at or after* the specified timestamp (in [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format).

params.name: oldest_ref
params.description: Filters the results by the reference ID of transaction events and returns only transactions with events whose IDs are *greater* than the specified value. This parameters supersedes the `oldest_time` parameter (if both are provided in the request).

items.docs: Lists detailed history of all transactions associated with the merchant profile.
